name: discord-style-login
description: Parameterised Discord-shaped login flow against a mocked form. Demonstrates {{email}} / {{password}} substitution. NOT a real Discord macro — selectors are demo-only and the page is injected.

actions.expression: document.body.innerHTML = '<form><input name=email id=email><input name=password type=password id=password><button id=submit type=button>Log in</button></form>'
